title: HTTP/3 doesn't support mutual TLS authentication
body:

### I did this
web server: written by Go with `github.com/lucas-clemente/quic-go` package. The server uses HTTP/3 and enables mutual TLS authentication.
Execute curl command to test, it returns an error:
```
➜ src/curl -vk --key /home/nitro/projects/broker-go/testdata/client.key --cert /home/nitro/projects/broker-go/testdata/client.crt --http3 https://localhost:8888/ping
*   Trying 127.0.0.1:8888...
* Connect socket 5 over QUIC to 127.0.0.1:8888
* Connected to localhost () port 8888 (#0)
* Using HTTP/3 Stream ID: 0 (easy handle 0x1b4b670)
> GET /ping HTTP/3
> Host: localhost:8888
> user-agent: curl/7.79.0-DEV
> accept: */*
>
* Connection #0 to host localhost left intact
curl: (56) Failure when receiving data from the peer
```

If anything works fine, `https://localhost:8888/ping` would return with 200 status code.
